items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Some of them used to think I was Indian, just like Lorenzo Teo, the great clarinet player, like I told you.

ctx.x: How did you get that name, Chai Nee, too?

You see, when I first started, as I told you once before, I was a little kid. I'll be 61 on the 19th of March, St. Joseph Cummins. Born 1900, I'm with the year. Well, I got the name of Chai Nee by playing with white and colored bands. See, when I was a little boy, well, musicians wasn't like you are today. Musicians were very sketchy. They didn't have jukeboxes and different things like that. Well, when I was a little boy, I used to play with white and colored bands, as I told you. And so, half of them thought I…
You were born right here in New Orleans?
